body:
📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #340 (last_seen before this fire: 2026-06-09T01:39:12Z; last_notified_at: 2026-06-08T12:07:35Z, ~24h 6m ago — past 24h suppression window).

DD monitor 77419271 *Unusual number of XHR errors for account* fired in #alert-frontend-errors at 12:06:12Z (singleton — first 06-09 fire after 10h 28m quiet stretch since G2 paired-fire at 01:38-01:39Z). DD log sample (last 13 min, 30 records / sample-capped) shows **20 distinct accounts** all failing with `http.status_code:0` (abort/timeout). Top accounts: tropicallogistixCo1, dewesoft, redeagleinternational, maconstructiongroup, indianaautomotiveequipment, firesafetyservicesinc2, directflooring, crslaboratories. Sample path: `/apps/api/dashboardview/GetApps` (canonical ki-21 shape).

*Playbook:* 1) Confirm chronic baseline by comparing ES Ocelot.Responder.Middleware Warning volume vs the same window 24h ago — if delta < 20%, chronic pattern. 2) Aggregate timeouts by RequestPath; dominant should be under `microservices.methodlocal.int` (pool-level). 3) Check `ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota` first — DNS bursts present here as Ocelot timeouts. 4) If DNS clean: identify which downstream microservice owns the slow path via Ocelot config in `ms-gateway-api/gateway/API/ocelot.*.json`. 5) Fix options: (a) raise per-route Ocelot timeout, (b) scale microservices IIS pool, (c) profile sync-util under prod load.

`fix_status: chronic-residual-post-rollback-2026-06-05` — 4 days post-rollback, recurrence pattern unchanged. Jira: none.

⚠️ *Coverage caveat:* ES `SourceContext:"Ocelot.Responder.Middleware.ResponderMiddleware"` returned **0 results** for the 11:30–12:10Z window. This is the 2nd time in ~7 days we have seen a ki-21 fire with no corroborating ES Ocelot signal. Either the ES pipeline is not indexing (chronic gap) or the upstream timeout cleared between fire and investigation. Worth surfacing in next stability-review — current playbook step 1 (baseline confirmation) depends on ES Ocelot delta.

📈 *Trend note:* 340th occurrence; +63 since 2026-06-08 12:12Z (277). The 06-08 8-cluster streak (~42 alerts) has cooled into this isolated 06-09 fire — possibly a settling signal. Cadence: 5 cap-saturated clusters 06-08 18:14–22:26Z → 1 overnight paired-fire 01:38–01:39Z → 10h 28m quiet → singleton at 12:06Z.

  • Kibana (ES Ocelot — 0 results, coverage caveat): https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:%272026-06-09T11:30:00Z%27,to:%272026-06-09T12:10:00Z%27))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:%27SourceContext%3A%22Ocelot.Responder.Middleware.ResponderMiddleware%22%27))
  • Investigation: docs/investigations/2026-06-09-1d50e8c3daeab8ef.md

🚨 swat-bypass DM: PL-63508 Avast/Norton miurl.cc false-positive recurrence (3rd status surface in 18h, 48h vendor review pending). Plus storm context (ki-21+ki-24 joint, eyes reactions, NEW Redis-error corroboration). See investigation 9b6cb6573ca3c433.

ki-24 every-10th-occurrence resurface DM (occ 110); Screen Load p95 peak 12.91s @ 14:59Z + Action Exec 9.92s; cross-channel co-fire Group A+E; 2nd consecutive cycle multi-group elevation; both monitors still in Alert state at 15:08Z; stability-review flag for severity-based escalation override on ki-24.

swat 14:43:31Z Ashur reports email.methodintegration.com/ls/click 404; operator Arash diagnosed DNS cache + applied fix at 14:49:20Z; 10 thread replies; in-thread workarounds (incognito/refresh) confirmed; DIFFERENT from PL-63508 AV false-positive on miurl.cc (different mechanism, different host, same broken-email-link customer impact); stability-review point: 2 email-link incidents in 24h on different surfaces.
